name: Thaere Privo
description: Thaere Privo was a planet located within the Thaereian system of the Expansion Region. The Galactic Senate tasked Thaere with protecting the Cularin system in a neighboring sector. Thaere joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
